name: IRAS 20551-4250 (Webb)
blurb: IRAS 20551-4250, an ultraluminous infrared galaxy formed by two colliding galaxies, seen by Webb.
label: ir20551-webb
story: Two disk galaxies have crashed together and are merging into one, flinging out tidal tails as they go. The tangled system blazes in infrared light.

claims.text: IRAS 20551-4250 is an ultraluminous infrared galaxy (ULIRG)
Also named ESO 286-19 or ESO 286-IG019; called IR20551
It is a late-stage merger with tidal tails
It formed from two disc galaxies now colliding and is an exceptionally luminous infrared source
